Name: CP - Lucky Clover
Author: NeoLuna
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][size=5][b][u]Lucky Clover for Content Patcher

[/u][/b][/size][/center][size=3][left]A Content Patcher conversion of FishWaffles64's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3568]Lucky Clover mod[/url]﻿ per the permissions given on the mod page. [/left]
[b][u][left]﻿Original Description[/left][/u][/b][/size]
[color=#00FF00][code][quote] Using Json Assets, you can now grow Lucky Clovers in spring! They take 4 days to grow, and have a hefty Luck buff when eaten.
You can buy the seeds from Pierre's for 200g!" [/quote][/code][/color]
[b][u][center]﻿[/center][left]Content Patcher Version[/left][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]The seeds are purchasable from Pierre's Shop in spring and cost 200g* each.
[*]Lucky clovers take 4 days to grow. They yield 1-3 on harvest with an increase of 5 per farm level. There is also a 0.2 extra harvest chance.
[*]Lucky clovers are edible and give +3 luck for 10mins.
[*]The seeds sell for 50g and the lucky clover 150g.
[*]The seeds are an universal like and the lucky clover an universal love. 
[*]The mod has been set up to support i18n for translations. Translations welcome.
[*]Yields and costs for seeds and crops are configurable. *Seeds cost will effect Pierre's sell price.
[*]The addition of a tea made using tea leaves, lucky clover, and maple syrup. Sells for 400g and is a universal love. It also gives a +3 Luck, +25 stamina, and +1.2 speed. The buff lasts 5mins. The sprite is based on the vanilla Stardrop Tea sprite.
[/list][left][/left][list]
[/list][b][u][center]﻿[/center][left]﻿Future Plans[/left]
[/u][/b]No guarantees on the following, however may;[list]
[*]add compatibility with other mods. Though, others are free to include compatibility in their own.
[/list]

Please let me know of any issues.
